issues.detail: The skill does not explicitly cover error handling or edge cases for all operations.
The implementation relies on Node.js and Microsoft Graph SDK, which is a minor platform assumption.

scenarios.name: upload-large-file-and-share
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric with correct Graph API calls, conflict behavior, resumable upload, and sharing; Response A uses Google Drive API and misses all required endpoints.

scenarios.name: delta-sync-and-cleanup
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies all rubric items, while Response A omits the use of @odata.deltaLink and instead relies on a deltaToken, missing a key requirement.
